purpose: Teach: フライパン/ティーン/ステッカー/サボっ/つぼみ/吠え/きゅう/じわじわ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、家庭科で、本気で、絶対、フライパン、絶対、使う授業、絶対、楽しかったよね
lines.en: Riku — that home-ec class with the frying pan was actually really fun, wasn't it?
lines.style: Bright, teasing opening. Light energy. Quick pace. Testing whether he'll remember the same moment she does.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。俺たち、本気で、絶対、もう、絶対、ティーンエイジャーだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. We're already teenagers now, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Slight wonder underneath. Slower pace than her brightness. Like he's turning the fact over in his mind.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ステッカー、絶対、コレクション、絶対、多いよね、リク
lines.en: You've got a pretty massive sticker collection, don't you?
lines.style: Curious, genuine interest. Not teasing this time. Leans in slightly. Noticing something about him she's been wondering about.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、本気で、絶対、サボったこと、絶対、ないんだぜ、俺、本気で、絶対、誇り
lines.en: I've never skipped club. Not once. I'm actually proud of that.
lines.style: Steady conviction. Light emphasis on the commitment. Sincere underneath the cool exterior. A small reveal.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の桜の、本気で、絶対、つぼみ、絶対、ふくらんできたよね、リク
lines.en: The cherry blossoms on the school grounds — their buds are really starting to swell, aren't they?
lines.style: Animated, noticing beauty. Quick pace, alive. Soft pause before 'buds'. Sharing something that made her stop and look.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、犬、絶対、よく、絶対、吠えるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: My grandpa's dog barks all the time. Pretty relentless.
lines.style: Wry half-smile in the voice. Casual, understated complaint. Light pace. A small exhale of acceptance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、きゅうに、絶対、忙しくなったよね、リク、本気で、絶対、心配
lines.en: You've gotten really busy all of a sudden. I've been kind of worried, actually.
lines.style: Concern underneath. Hesitant — vulnerable for her. Quiet, searching. Checking whether he'll let her in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の点数、本気で、絶対、じわじわと、絶対、上がってきてるよね、桜、本気で、絶対、応援
lines.en: Your grades have been climbing lately. I'm really proud of you.
lines.style: Warm and direct. Small emphasis on 'climbing' — noticing the effort. Sincere, no irony. A genuine compliment she means.
